windowProjection.method: Retention bands measured on run B's ledger (kept bytes / original bytes per shaped unit), applied per file, divided by 4 bytes per token; cumulative adds 1,327 B of user-message overhead per shaped result at 0.179 shaped results per file.
windowProjection.shapedResultsPerFileSource: run B measured 35 shaped results / 195 results per file = 0.179 (the code path that produced these numbers)
assumptions: Retention ratios come from run B's ledger on the same brief shape, not from this image.
4 bytes per token is a flat divisor; CJK corpus (T11, T12) will under- or over-read against it.
The 1,327 B overhead applies only to shaped (tool-result) replies, at the measured run-B rate.
Estimate is transcript-only, the same quantity the mount's half-window trigger reads.

expectedFiresNote: The mount prunes at half of --window-tokens 400 000, so the bar is ~200 000 tokens. The cumulative estimate passes 200 000 during T8 (181k after T7, 204k after T8) and passes 400 000 during T11 (394k after T10, 452k after T11). So fire 1 lands in T8; fire 2 lands in T11, at the host's native compaction bar, and therefore races compaction rather than clearing it early. If fire 2 loses that race the round records one fire: an informative partial, not a failed run. Method: retention bands 0.695/0.431/0.196/0.04/0.02, divisor 4 bytes per token.
